nusmp.page.book_water.sea_dragons_wrath: Sea Dragon's Wrath - three sea dragons fan out from you; each one hits what it reaches for 14 and throws it back. Scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_water.tide_lance: Valkyrie Tide Lance - a great lance of water, thrown from the armour's hand: 22 damage to everything on its line, and it pushes them back.
nusmp.page.book_water.scale_mail: Sea Dragon's Scale Mail - scales of water close over you: absorption hearts and resistance for fifteen seconds, and allies near you are healed.
nusmp.page.book_water.torrent: Sea Dragon's Torrent - a cone of rushing water nine blocks long: damage, a hard push and Slowness. The cone grows with your EP.
